$comment: Written by hand. Two responses of one chat. The first delegates one batch of two children, a review and a research task, and synthesises their findings. The second resumes the research child with a follow-up. Each response lists the parent's turns in order; the children are listed once, by their objectives. A word beginning with $ stands for what the run learns: $reference:N is the ledger id of a child's Nth reference, $task:T the id of the task titled T.
